requirements.description: Solid insulating materials with a safety function shall withstand dielectric strength test voltages
Resistance to heat retained by all insulation and insulating partition walls during EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE of ME EQUIPMENT

Insulating characteristics and mechanical strength of all MEANS OF PROTECTION not likely to be impaired by environmental stresses including deposition of dirt resulting from wear of parts within EQUIPMENT, potentially reducing CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES below 8.9

CREEPAGE DISTANCES and AIR CLEARANCES are to values in Tables 12 to 16 (inclusive); insulation between parts of opposite polarity of MAINS PART on supply mains side of any mains fuse or OVER-CURRENT RELEASE, one MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION to values in Table 13, Table 14 and Table 16

semantic_fragments.content: Finished wire with spirally wrapped or multi-layer extruded insulation complying with Annex L: BASIC INSULATION requires minimum two wrapped layers or one extruded layer; SUPPLEMENTARY INSULATION requires minimum two layers, wrapped or extruded; REINFORCED INSULATION requires minimum three layers, wrapped or extruded. In spirally wrapped insulation with CREEPAGE DISTANCES between layers less than in Table 12 or 16 (Pollution Degree 1), path between layers shall be sealed as a cemented joint in 8.9.3.3 and test voltages of TYPE TESTS in L.3 equal 1.6 times of normal values. All items marked N/A as no spirally wrapped insulation present.

Protection against mechanical stress shall be provided where two insulated wires or one bare and one insulated wire are in contact inside wound component, crossing at an angle between 45° and 90° and subject to winding tension. Finished component shall comply with routine dielectric strength tests of 8.8.3. Tests of Annex L not repeated since material data sheets confirm compliance. All items marked N/A.
Ball pressure test exemptions: Test not performed on parts of ceramic material, insulating parts of commutators, brush-caps, and similar, and on coil formers not used as REINFORCED INSULATION (N/A).

Insulation between parts of opposite polarity of the MAINS PART on the supply mains side of any mains fuse or OVER-CURRENT RELEASE: one MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION values are to be in accordance with Table 13, Table 14 and Table 16. Verdict: P.
